title: Hunters online
summary: Hunter-net and its mailing list as both tool and weakness.

claims.text: Imbued trade field reports and warnings by email and on hunter-net lists, where good information travels fast but so do flame wars, smears and false leads.
Monsters can hide in plain sight online, posing as hunters or informants and steering the chosen toward weak foes, raging ones or traps.

title: Ichmail and the Orphic Circle
summary: A dead thing that joined the hunter list.

claims.text: A being calling itself Ichmail, by its own account one of the dead, began writing to the online hunter community and spoke of something called the Orphic Circle.
The poster Oracle171 later sent messages describing an unearthly exploration of Ichmail's Orphic Circle.
Hunters must weigh anything the dead tell them about ghosts, zombies or the purpose of the imbued, since it comes from the very things they fight.

title: Haiti's restless dead
summary: Field reports of a walking-dead threat in Haiti.

claims.text: The hunter Shaka74 posted a series of field reports while investigating a menace of restless dead in Haiti.
